ORDER BY `rsa`.`ndc` DESC

column1: Need to Test Functionality of Cart post load when large number of products in cart
column31:
Issue: When 400+ products in cart, change supplier functionality doesn't load any results unless you let the page sit for 15 or so minutes before doing anything.

Need to test all Cart functionality post load of page to see if any optimizations can be implemented to increase speed and functionality.

Example Login DEA: FV2145503

Per Jeff: The issue with the shopping cart is the calculating the potential savings the shows in the bubble on the change supplier.   Once you get over 150 or so products, that's 150 queries to get the potential savings, and those requests to the backend block other operations on the front end.

Also for more full carts (300+ products) pulling all the images for 300 products uses up 300 requests, and the browsers have limits on the number of concurrent request, so just loading all those product images prevents other backend services from even starting, compounding the problem greatly.

  1. Some symptoms that begin to appear as more and more products are loaded: 
    1. Change supplier opens, but no results appear to choose another product.
    2. Recommended products will not open
    3. Scolling down the page, freezes at times.
    4. Chrome seems to be worse than Firefox even.
    5. Delete product will not delete the product.
    6. For some customers (and our customer service team) the browser just locks up eventually and won't respond to anything.

I have also setup the test user:  LK1234578 on Production with 320 items in the cart as an example.   As of next week this will be on staging.   We will have to refresh the items in the cart if too much time has gone by - as the listiing will be expiring, going away over time.
